card_description:
**Priority:** P0 | **Location:** Santa Monica/New York | **AUM:** $650M+ (Two $325M Funds)

**Investment Thesis:**
Leading VC at the intersection of content, technology and social commerce with emphasis on video games and the infrastructure powering immersive virtual worlds. Invests where AI, spatial computing, blockchain, and human creativity converge to redefine how we live, work, and play.

**Why They're a Good Target:**
- Core thesis: 'What would you invest in if you believe younger generations are moving en masse from the physical to the digital world?' - aligns with live service/metaverse infrastructure
- 7 unicorns in portfolio: The Sandbox (became unicorn 2024), Immutable, Mythical Games, and others
- 75+ investments including Sky Mavis (Axie Infinity), Genvid (interactive live streaming), Bad Robot Games
- Sam Englebardt: Harvard Law, co-founder Galaxy Digital (TSX: GLXY), deep finance + gaming crossover
- Richard Kim: Founding GP with interactive entertainment focus
- Portfolio emphasizes infrastructure: Mythical Games (blockchain gaming), Immutable (web3 gaming), Genvid (streaming tech)
- $650M AUM with follow-on capacity for Series A/B

**Key Partners:**

| Name | Title | Background | Priority |
|------|-------|------------|----------|
| Sam Englebardt | Founding General Partner | Harvard Law, co-founder Galaxy Digital, finance/gaming crossover | PRIMARY |
| Richard Kim | General Partner | Interactive entertainment, gaming/media investor | PRIMARY |
| Jeff Brown | Partner | Operations and venture building | SECONDARY |
| Gaurav Bhogale | Vice President | Investment and portfolio support | TERTIARY |

**Portfolio Companies (Recent):**
- The Sandbox (unicorn 2024) - Metaverse platform
- Immutable - Blockchain gaming infrastructure (unicorn)
- Mythical Games - Blockchain gaming platform (unicorn)
- Sky Mavis - Axie Infinity developer
- Genvid - Interactive live streaming technology
- Bad Robot Games - J.J. Abrams' game studio
- GreenPark Sports - Sports virtual world
- StockX - Marketplace (also gaming adjacent)
- Bunch - Multiplayer gaming platform (acquired by Meta)

**Warm Path Opportunities:**
- Galaxy Digital network connections
- Web3 gaming ecosystem (Immutable, Mythical Games alumni)
- Metaverse/virtual world connections (The Sandbox ecosystem)
- Harvard Law/network connections
- iHeartMedia board connections (Sam Englebardt is board member)

**Recommended Outreach Angle:**
**Subject:** Seed-Stage [Live Service Infrastructure] - Building the Metaverse Stack

**Hook:** Lead with metaverse infrastructure thesis alignment. Reference their Genvid or Mythical Games investments as validation of infrastructure appetite. Sam responds to big visions about the future of digital living - emphasize how live service tools enable the 'physical to digital' migration they invest behind.

**Key Talking Points:**
1. Infrastructure for the 'generational shift' from physical to digital worlds
2. Live service game operations as foundational metaverse layer
3. AI-augmented multiplayer experiences (aligns with Genvid/Mythical thesis)
4. Platform-layer investment with network effects
5. Technical team that can scale across gaming and metaverse use cases

**Contact Information:**
- Sam Englebardt: sam_englebardt@galaxy.com or sam@galaxyinteractive.io | LinkedIn: /in/samenglebardt
- Website: https://interactive.galaxy.com
- Fund: $650M+ AUM across two funds, active deployment

**Research Sources:**
- https://interactive.galaxy.com/
- https://interactive.galaxy.com/investments
- Forbes: Galaxy Interactive raises $325M Fund 2 (Oct 2021)
- Tracxn: Galaxy Interactive profile
- CoinTelegraph: Galaxy metaverse/gaming fund coverage

**Next Action:** Send personalized cold email to Sam Englebardt emphasizing metaverse infrastructure and live service gaming thesis alignment.
checklist: Research Sam Englebardt recent interviews/media (Forbes, Galaxy insights)
Check for Galaxy Digital or Mythical Games network connections
Draft personalized outreach referencing Genvid/Mythical infrastructure thesis
Send cold email to Sam Englebardt with metaverse infrastructure angle
Follow up if no response in 7 days
